Ltd was founded by the late Lawrence Camilleri in 1979 with one purpose in mind – to serve the Maltese maritime industry with an outstanding service and guarantee in quality. Consequently, Ellcee Nautical Supplies Co Ltd which is now trading as Camilleri Marine, evolved from a retailer to an importer, manufacturer and a distributor offering specialized services to keep your vessel sailing.
